name: Sony portable speaker — hypothetical concept

connectivity: Pair two compatible units for stereo
baseline.sound_positioning: Everyday portable listening; no verified superiority claim
baseline.replacement_condition: Open only when dry; securely close before water exposure

standout: Tool-free user-swappable battery, replaceable in under a minute.
selling_point: Keep the speaker. Swap the battery.
research_question: How does preference compare with existing speakers and keeping a current device?
design_notes: Proposed specifications, not an actual Sony launch or measured market median. Battery, protection, and replacement time are engineering targets. No two deliberate disadvantages were agreed for this original concept.
